storyCards.headline: Toot It And Boot It: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Yg's "Toot It And Boot It" reached #67 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Toot It and Boot It" is the debut single by American rapper YG featuring uncredited vocals from American singer Ty Dolla Sign, taken from the former's second mixtape, The Real 4Fingaz (2010).

The song peaked at #67 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 11 weeks on the chart.

Toot It And Boot It was released in 2010.
